_doc: Fixed fixtures for test_live_lineup_page.py / test_live_events_page.py (27 Oct 2026): real match ids from football.db, rewritten in an IN-MEMORY copy to the shape each test needs, with fixed far-future kick-offs so nothing depends on today's real fixtures. The real football.db is only read.

upcoming.why: EGY: made upcoming (no score, NS) and stripped of lineups/stats/events/goals -> page gets the live Lineups slot (#lulive) and #evlive

static_lineup.why: MAR, finished with a stored lineup -> static pitch, no live slot

goals_only.why: IRQ, finished with goals; its events rows are removed -> goals-only list replaced by the worker's full copy

saved_events.why: SAU, finished with saved events -> no #evlive, static list kept
